about_the_game:
The final part of the Five Nights at Restroom story is here.
Five Nights at Restroom: Part 3 is an expansion for Five Nights at Restroom 2 divided into four acts that concludes the game’s story.

Act 1: Survive the Night
The first night in a new place is always the hardest—but if it’s in a new life, it’s even worse. Elliot has been reincarnated and now must survive the first night to build the time machine during the day.

Act 2: Build Our Machine
Elliot now has to search for the missing parts of the time machine. To do that, he’ll have to go to some familiar places.

Act 3: Customized Diarrhea
Elliot is now inside the time machine. Monsters are breaking through space and time and entering where he is. Will he be able to survive?

Act 4: The Rift Zone
Elliot must now return to where it all began and stop it. To do that, he has to go back to Soggy Pizza and blow everything up.

content_descriptors.notes: In the game’s finale, the final boss is defeated by an explosive weapon shot (with blood and gore).
